response.sql:
WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT raceId,
         AVG(CASE WHEN points >= 6.0 THEN points END) AS avg_points,
         AVG(CASE WHEN points >= 6.0 THEN wins END) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings
  GROUP BY raceId
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins
  FROM per_race
)
SELECT p.raceId,
       p.avg_points,
       p.avg_wins,
       p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS difference
FROM per_race AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The points threshold selects standings entries; each race's averages include only entries with points at least 6.0, while AVG ignores NULL points or wins. The overall average includes races with a non-NULL per-race average wins.
